about: "מנוע הנפשות" — the kiosk's Motion Engine, one table for every renderer: pos-server app/services/kiosk_motion.py (validation, limits), pos-android domain/KioskMotionEngine.kt, the dashboard's and the web / Windows kiosks' client/src/lib/kioskMotionEngine.ts. Generated from kiosk_motion.py; byte-identical in pos-server server/tests/fixtures and pos-android app/src/test/resources — change it in both repos together. resolveDuration(k, default, override): the override as is, else round(default × k), halves up.

cases.name: a new kiosk: Runner Standard, the wolt style's kinds
the spec's example: Slow, AddToCart 700 → 910, with an override of 1050 → 1050
a kiosk from before the engine (migration): legacy, its older choices and speed
an older config with no engine keys at all: Standard timings, its kinds and speed
the hierarchy: company Standard, shop Slow, kiosk Custom AddToCart 1050 / category 700
custom multiplier, explicit kinds and parameters, a disabled event
the light profile (a weak device): plain kinds, no cascade, no slower than fast
reduced motion: each event's fallback, half its time, never a loop
legacy with reduced motion: as before the engine — no transitions, the add a short fade
invalid values are ignored (the preset's stay)
